column2: Fresh -cfgfile profiles copied from the clean Default 7 profile; no custom keymap, mouse map, or third-party extensions
Track A has MIDI items/takes A1 (pitch 60) and A2 (pitch 62); Track B has B1 (pitch 64) and B2 (pitch 65).
Real X11 clicks set item selections. Then REAPER Main action 40153 opens the built-in MIDI editor. The probe records MIDIEditor_GetTake and its owning item.

GetSelectedMediaItem enumeration follows project order. With A1/B1 selected and B1 clicked last, MIDIEditor_GetTake is A1. Adding hovered A2 with 40529 leaves the active editor take at A1. After 40530 removes A1 from A1/A2/B1, the editor take becomes A2, the first remaining item in project order. This is editor-specific take selection; it does not expose a separate Arrange-level active item.
